answer: Make each identity carry a walnut-hardened key: a hardware secret that cannot be copied, so one device yields exactly one agent. Verification works like a prism, splitting the proof into separate facets - attestation, a small refundable stake, and a history of useful work - and a forgery must pass every facet at once. Every live agent also broadcasts a signed beacon heartbeat each epoch; clones sharing one enclave cannot beacon from two places at once without splitting their compute. Scaling a Sybil farm means buying real hardware per identity, capping the attack at hardware cost.
